effectiveTerms: MAME licence (non-commercial) over ISC, with MIT integration
note: ares itself is ISC and would permit commercial use, but this core replaces ares' Vulkan renderer with angrylion's software RDP, which descends from MESS and carries the MAME licence: redistribution is permitted, sale and commercial use are not. The built core is therefore distributable under those terms and no others. The same shape as the gpgx, opera and snes9x packages.

components.name: angrylion RDP (mylittle-nocomment)
components.note: The N64's display processor, rasterised in software. This is what makes the core's picture the same on every machine; ares' own renderer needs a Vulkan driver, which a movie cannot depend on.

components.name: sljit
components.note: ares' recompiler back end. Compiled in but not used: this core forces both interpreters, because a sandbox cannot host generated code and a movie cannot depend on it.

components.name: TZXFile
components.note: Reached through mia, ares' media loader.

components.name: ymfm
components.note: Yamaha FM sound chips, reached through the Famicom's expansion audio and the Neo Geo's.

components.name: qon / qoi2
components.note: The video codec ares uses for LaserActive media; compiled in because the PC Engine and Mega Drive cores reference it.
